Perfect! The issue was in the `bulk_discount` function in `shopcart/pricing.py`. The condition was using `>` (strictly greater than) instead of `>=` (greater than or equal to), which meant the discount wasn't being applied when the quantity exactly matched the threshold.

**The fix:** Changed line 14 from `if qty > BULK_THRESHOLD:` to `if qty >= BULK_THRESHOLD:` so that the 10% bulk discount is applied when buying 10 or more units, as the docstring and tests indicate.

All 126 tests now pass.
